component.name: Musicwell
component.summary: A simple or fully customisable music player

description.p: Musicwell is a music player for your own music library — as simple or as arranged as you like.
Add your music folder and everything is there, with covers, artist photos, lyrics and a visualizer. Or unlock the window and put every item where you want it, at any size, and save your own layouts.

ul.li: Library with a column browser, artist pages, all albums as covers, ratings and stats
Lyrics, artist information, covers and photos looked up for you
Equalizer, gapless playback, fades and volume levelling
Internet radio, and Discover music like the song playing
Cast to Chromecast and play on Sonos speakers
